# Environment HDRI

`studio_small_08_1k.hdr` — soft, low-contrast indoor studio softbox lighting.
Source: [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com/a/studio_small_08), CC0 (public
domain — no attribution required, used here anyway for provenance). 1k
resolution chosen for a small, fast-loading web asset; swap for the 2k/4k
version from the same page if more reflection detail is ever needed.
